teaser: Why Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup and Partiful block sites like ours, who owns an event listing, what the law allows, and how we collect now.
core_idea: Event listings belong to organisers, who grant platforms only non-exclusive licences; facts can be stated with a link, while descriptions, photos and wholesale copying need permission, so the lawful routes are organisers' permission, readable agendas and facts with links.

nodes.label: The law
nodes.summary: Facts, copyright, database right, contract, GDPR.

nodes.label: How we collect
nodes.summary: Agendas, facts and links, submissions, register.

quotes.text: An organiser who publishes publicly wants to be found.
part of "they do not let us" was us, not them
